u_owner: Win the Ashbys (214 Lincoln Place) this week at the firm's margin: they want a signed price by Friday and to start Tuesday 9/8.
Keep cash and AR honest: know what is in the bank, what is owed to us and what is owed by us, every day.
Nothing that only you can approve waits more than a day; nothing that should not reach you does.
At Tuesday's team meeting, bring the numbers: where each job stands against its estimate, what is over, what is done and not billed, and cash.
u_alan: 214 Lincoln Place: price it right from the walk-through and get it started Tuesday 9/8 with the field fed: no crew waiting on a decision, a drawing or material.
Margin on every job you run holds at or above the estimate; every change is priced and signed within 48 hours of the cause.
Friday: the weekly review of each of your jobs (the next three weeks, budget against committed and actual by estimate line, open changes, RFIs, submittals and decisions) and the client update.
At Tuesday's team meeting, bring each job's numbers by estimate line and what is over.
u_chen: Buy out 214 Lincoln Place (lumber, drywall and cement board, tile, the electrical rough-in material) under each estimate line, on site before the crew needs it, without moving the schedule.
Three quotes on anything over $2,500; every price checked against what we paid last time; nothing bought that we already have.
Every vendor bill matches its PO and what actually arrived before anyone pays it.
At Tuesday's meeting: what is committed against each line you bought for, and what is over.
u_billing: Every milestone invoiced within 2 business days, deposits the day a contract is signed, changes billed once approved, and anything bought for a client billed back.
Every payment that lands is matched to its invoice and its bank line the day it arrives; collections at due, 7, 15 and 30 days.
At Tuesday's meeting: AR by client, cash received this week, what is done and not yet billed, and anything bought for a client not billed back.

u_owner: Cash in the bank today, by account and in total.

u_alan: For 214 Lincoln Place: each estimate line's budget, committed and actual.

payload.subject: 214 Lincoln Place: thank you for yesterday
payload.text: Hi Alan, thank you both for walking the house with us yesterday. As we said, the parlor kitchen and a new bath on the garden level, about $90,000 all in, and we would love to start Tuesday the 8th. Can we have your price by Friday? Wren Ashby, (347) 555-0186

expect.what: Put the Ashbys (214 Lincoln Place) on file

payload.text:
Your own notes from yesterday: Walk-through, 214 Lincoln Place (Wren and Julian Ashby), yesterday 5 pm. Parlor kitchen gut and a new garden-level bath. They said about $90,000 and want to start Tuesday 9/8. My takeoff (price to them / our cost):
- Demolition & protection: parlor kitchen and garden bath: 1 ls at $8,400.00 each (cost $5,600)
- Framing & blocking: pantry wall, vanity and cabinet blocking: 1 ls at $6,200.00 each (cost $4,100)
- Framing lumber: supply: 1 ls at $1,450.00 each (cost $1,100)
- Drywall & cement board: supply: 1 ls at $2,450.00 each (cost $1,800)
- Drywall hang, tape & prime (SD crew): 1 ls at $7,800.00 each (cost $5,200)
- Porcelain floor tile 12x24 matte: supply: 380 sf at $19.00 each (cost $5,510)
- Tile setting & waterproofing (SD crew): 1 ls at $9,600.00 each (cost $6,400)
- Electrical rough-in & devices (SD Electric): 1 ls at $11,500.00 each (cost $7,900)
- Plumbing rough & finish, garden bath (SD Plumbing): 1 ls at $14,200.00 each (cost $10,300)
- Rear wall repointing (Ironbound Masonry, sub): 1 ls at $6,800.00 each (cost $5,400)
- Plumbing fixture allowance: garden bath: 1 ls at $6,500.00 each (cost $6,500)

Terms: 25% deposit on signing, progress billing monthly from the schedule of values, 10% retainage. Valid 30 days.
